sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: At some point in your life, you probably encountered a problem in the built world,
sentences.zh: 在你人生的某个时刻，你可能在现实世界中遇到过一个问题，

sentences.en: something that was poorly designed and the fix was obvious to you.
sentences.zh: 某个设计得很糟糕，而你一眼就能看出如何修复的东西。

sentences.en: Maybe a door that opened the wrong way, or a poorly painted marker on the road.
sentences.zh: 也许是一扇开错方向的门，或者路面上画得不清楚的标志。

sentences.en: I notice this kind of stuff all the time, even more so now after creating this show.
sentences.zh: 我总是能注意到这类事情，在制作了这个节目之后，更是如此。

sentences.en: I'm sorry if you do too, because you listen to this show.
sentences.zh: 如果你也这样，我很抱歉，因为这都是因为你听了这个节目。

sentences.en: And mostly when we see these things, we grumble on the inside, and then do nothing.
sentences.zh: 而且大多数时候，当我们看到这些东西时，我们只是在心里抱怨一下，然后什么也不做。

sentences.en: There are all sorts of reasons for our inertia.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以无动于衷，原因有很多。

sentences.en: We don't know how to fix it.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道怎么修。

sentences.en: It's not ours to fix.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们该修的。

sentences.en: We could get in trouble.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: That's producer David Weinberg.
sentences.zh: 那是制片人大卫·温伯格。

sentences.en: You might notice these little design flaws for years, silently fuming.
sentences.zh: 你可能多年来一直注意到这些小小的设计缺陷，默默地感到愤怒。

sentences.en: Until one day.
sentences.zh: 直到有一天。

sentences.en: He called me and said, you know, okay, we're doing it.
sentences.zh: 他打电话给我说，你知道吗，好吧，我们要行动了。

sentences.en: It was early Sunday morning, August 5th, 2001, in Los Angeles, California.
sentences.zh: 那是2001年8月5日，一个周日的清晨，地点在加利福尼亚州的洛杉矶。

sentences.en: Richard Ankram and a group of friends were on the 4th Street Bridge over the 110 Freeway.
sentences.zh: 理查德·安克拉姆和一群朋友当时正在110号高速公路上的第四街大桥上。

sentences.en: They were about to commit a crime.
sentences.zh: 他们正准备去犯罪。

sentences.en: It's going to be a high-profile, dangerous situation.
sentences.zh: 这将是一场备受瞩目、危险重重的行动。

sentences.en: Not only could I get arrested, I could kill somebody.
sentences.zh: 我不仅可能被捕，还可能害死人。

sentences.en: Really, I was terrified of that.
sentences.zh: 说真的，我对此感到恐惧。

sentences.en: But let's back up.
sentences.zh: 但让我们回顾一下。

sentences.en: About 20 years prior, Richard Ankram, an artist living in Orange County, was driving north on the 110 Freeway.
sentences.zh: 大约20年前，住在奥兰治县的艺术家理查德·安克拉姆正开车在110号高速公路上向北行驶。

sentences.en: As he passed through downtown Los Angeles, he was going to merge onto another freeway, the I-5 North.
sentences.zh: 当他穿过洛杉矶市中心时，他本打算并入另一条高速公路，即5号州际公路北向。

sentences.en: But he missed the exit and got loSt.
sentences.zh: 但他错过了出口，迷路了。

sentences.en: And for some reason, it just stuck with him.
sentences.zh: 不知为何，这件事一直萦绕在他心头。

sentences.en: Years later, when Richard moved to downtown Los Angeles,
sentences.zh: 多年后，当理查德搬到洛杉矶市中心时，

sentences.en: he was driving on the same stretch of freeway where he'd gotten lost a decade before,
sentences.zh: 他开车经过十年前他迷路的那段高速公路，

sentences.en: when he looked up at the big green rectangular sign suspended above.
sentences.zh: 抬头看向悬挂在上方的大型绿色长方形标志。

sentences.en: I realized why I missed the exit.
sentences.zh: 我意识到我为什么会错过那个出口了。

sentences.en: It's because it wasn't adequately signed.
sentences.zh: 因为那里的指示不够充分。

sentences.en: Bad wayfinding.
sentences.zh: 寻路系统太差了。

sentences.en: The exit for the I-5 wasn't indicated on the green overhead sign.
sentences.zh: 绿色高架标志上没有标出5号州际公路的出口。

sentences.en: There was even a big open space where there should have been a blue and red interstate shield.
sentences.zh: 那里甚至有一大片空白，本该放上蓝红相间的州际公路盾形标志。

sentences.en: And above that, it should have said north.
sentences.zh: 而在那上方，本该写着“北”。

sentences.en: It was clear to Richard that Caltrans, the California Department of Transportation, had made a mistake.
sentences.zh: 理查德很清楚，加州交通局（Caltrans）犯了一个错误。

sentences.en: So Richard, an artist and sign painter, decided to make the Interstate 5 North Shield himself
sentences.zh: 于是，身为艺术家和标志画家的理查德决定自己制作那个5号州际公路北向的盾形标志，

sentences.en: and install it in the place he thought it should have been all along, high above the 110 Freeway.
sentences.zh: 并把它安装在他认为它本该存在的地方——110号高速公路的高空之上。

sentences.en: He would call it an act of guerrilla public service.
sentences.zh: 他称之为一种“游击式公共服务”行为。

sentences.en: The whole idea was to be sort of a public servant or actually to show what you can do with artwork.
sentences.zh: 整个想法就是做一个公共服务人员，或者说，展示艺术作品能做些什么。

sentences.en: You can put it in plain sight and have a functioning, working thing for everyone to use.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它放在显眼的地方，让它成为每个人都能使用的实用工具。

sentences.en: Richard started by studying L.A.
sentences.zh: 理查德首先研究了洛杉矶的高速公路标志，

sentences.en: freeway signs, holding up Pantone swatches to perfectly match the paint color.
sentences.zh: 拿着潘通色卡去完美匹配油漆颜色。

sentences.en: He dangled over bridges to measure the exact dimensions of other signs.
sentences.zh: 他悬挂在桥梁上测量其他标志的确切尺寸。

sentences.en: And most importantly, he downloaded the Necronomicon of California road signage, the Mutt Kid.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他下载了加州道路标志的“死灵之书”——《统一交通控制设备手册》（MUTCD）。

sentences.en: The M.U.T.C.D., the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices.
sentences.zh: M.U.T.C.D.，即《统一交通控制设备手册》。

sentences.en: Quote, to provide for uniform standards and specifications for all official traffic control devices in California.
sentences.zh: 引用语：“为加州所有官方交通控制设备提供统一的标准和规范。”

sentences.en: It's not a beach read.
sentences.zh: 这可不是什么海滩读物。

sentences.en: I have it.
sentences.zh: 我有这本书。

sentences.en: It's more of a lazy Sunday afternoon read.
sentences.zh: 它更适合在慵懒的周日下午阅读。

sentences.en: All the specs are online so people can bid on projects.
sentences.zh: 所有的规格都在网上，这样人们才能参与项目竞标。

sentences.en: Richard wanted his sign to be built to the exact specifications of Caltrans, which were designed to be read by motorists traveling at high speeds.
sentences.zh: 理查德希望他的标志能按照加州交通局的确切规格制作，这些规格是为了让高速行驶的驾驶员能够看清而设计的。

sentences.en: The shield with the vibe on it is three feet roughly high and wide.
sentences.zh: 那个带有标志的盾牌大约有三英尺高和宽。

sentences.en: It's less than an eighth of an inch, barely an eighth of an inch thick aluminum.
sentences.zh: 它不到八分之一英寸厚，铝板厚度勉强达到八分之一英寸。

sentences.en: It's still pretty strong.
sentences.zh: 但它依然非常坚固。

sentences.en: And above that, I put the word north.
sentences.zh: 在它上方，我加上了“北”这个词。

sentences.en: And that was, oh, about 14 inches by five feet.
sentences.zh: 大约是14英寸乘5英尺。

sentences.en: And again, I used the same typeface that was there and the same signs.
sentences.zh: 我再次使用了那里现有的字体和标志。

sentences.en: I tried to match everything as close as I could.
sentences.zh: 我尽量把一切都匹配得天衣无缝。

sentences.en: So it wouldn't be obvious Caltrans didn't do it.
sentences.zh: 这样就不会让人一眼看出不是加州交通局做的。

sentences.en: Richard's brand new additions had to blend in perfectly with the existing signage, which had been collecting dirt and smog for decades.
sentences.zh: 理查德全新的添加物必须与现有的标志完美融合，而那些标志已经积攒了数十年的灰尘和烟雾。

sentences.en: I sprayed the whole thing with a really thin glaze of gray and knocked down the shine.
sentences.zh: 我给整个标志喷上了一层非常薄的灰色釉料，去掉了光泽。

sentences.en: After he finished it, Richard signed his name on the back of it with a black marker, like a painter signing a canvas.
sentences.zh: 完成后，理查德在背面用黑色记号笔签上了自己的名字，就像画家在画布上签名一样。

sentences.en: Then came the next phase of the project, the installation, which he planned with the precision of a bank heiSt.
sentences.zh: 接下来是项目的下一阶段：安装。他像策划银行抢劫一样精确地计划了这次安装。

sentences.en: He bought a disguise, a white hard hat and an orange vest, so he'd look like a Caltrans worker.
sentences.zh: 他买了一套伪装服，一顶白色安全帽和一件橙色背心，这样看起来就像加州交通局的工人。

sentences.en: Basically looked the part as best I could.
sentences.zh: 基本上尽我所能看起来像那么回事。

sentences.en: And he made a decal for his pickup truck, meant to look vaguely official, that said, aesthetic deconstruction.
sentences.zh: 他还为他的皮卡车做了一个贴纸，看起来模棱两可地像官方标志，上面写着“美学解构”。

sentences.en: The night before the installation, Richard drove out to the site and hid some of his supplies so they'd be easy to get to the next morning.
sentences.zh: 安装前一天晚上，理查德开车到现场，藏好了一些补给品，以便第二天早上容易拿到。

sentences.en: When I interviewed him, he took me to the spot and showed me where he'd stashed his stuff.
sentences.zh: 当我采访他时，他带我去了那个地方，向我展示了他藏东西的地方。

sentences.en: Okay, we're basically here.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们基本到了。

sentences.en: Right now, the ivy isn't that thick, but it was a lot thicker.
sentences.zh: 现在常春藤没那么厚，但当时厚得多。

sentences.en: And I had, basically behind that tree, it stashed the ladder and the signs and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我基本上在那棵树后面藏了梯子、标志之类的东西。

sentences.en: After he hid his things, he climbed a tree and just sat there, going through everything in his head.
sentences.zh: 藏好东西后，他爬上一棵树坐着，在脑海中演练了一遍所有流程。

sentences.en: I just sort of calmed myself down by being there and hanging around with it the night before.
sentences.zh: 前一天晚上待在那里，和它待在一起，让我平静了下来。

sentences.en: Richard was worried that he might drop the sign or one of his tools onto the road below.
sentences.zh: 理查德很担心自己会把标志或工具掉到下面的路上。

sentences.en: Drivers going 60 plus miles an hour would have no time to react if something landed on the road in front of them or worse, onto their car.
sentences.zh: 如果有什么东西掉在路面上，或者更糟，掉在车上，时速60英里以上的司机根本来不及反应。

sentences.en: That was the scariest thing of the whole project, is if somebody got hurt, you know, I'd have to live with that.
sentences.zh: 那是整个项目中最可怕的事情，如果有人受伤，你知道，我得背负一辈子。

sentences.en: And then the project, I'd have to sh** in it, because it would have defeated the whole idea of it.
sentences.zh: 那样的话，这个项目就彻底搞砸了，因为它违背了初衷。

sentences.en: But despite some reservations, Richard was pretty confident he could pull the whole thing off.
sentences.zh: 但尽管有些顾虑，理查德还是相当自信能完成这一切。

sentences.en: And he'd gone too far to turn back.
sentences.zh: 而且他已经走得太远，无法回头了。

sentences.en: And that brings us back to the morning of August 5th, 2001.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带回了2001年8月5日的早晨。

sentences.en: Richard did not act alone.
sentences.zh: 理查德并非独自行动。

sentences.en: He asked several friends to film the installation from different vantage points.
sentences.zh: 他请了几位朋友从不同的角度拍摄安装过程。

sentences.en: Amy Inoa was one of the friends he enlisted to film.
sentences.zh: 艾米·伊诺亚就是他请来拍摄的朋友之一。

sentences.en: We did it at 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我们在早上6点

sentences.en: or 7 a.m.
sentences.zh: 或7点做的。

sentences.en: on a Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 那是一个周日的早晨。

sentences.en: It was tense because we all thought we were going to get into trouble.
sentences.zh: 当时气氛很紧张，因为我们都以为会惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: Richard had chosen a Sunday morning to put up the sign, knowing that there would be little traffic
sentences.zh: 理查德选择在周日早上安装标志，因为他知道那时候车流量很少，

sentences.en: and the morning light rising above the skyscrapers would be just right for filming.
sentences.zh: 而且摩天大楼上升起的晨光非常适合拍摄。

sentences.en: What he hadn't anticipated was that Caltrans had also picked that morning to do work on the same stretch of highway.
sentences.zh: 他没料到的是，加州交通局也选在那个早晨在同一路段施工。

sentences.en: Yes, they happened to be doing some other work on the freeway just south of that sign.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们碰巧在那块标志南面的高速公路上进行其他工作。

sentences.en: When they saw the Caltrans workers, they thought about turning back.
sentences.zh: 当他们看到加州交通局的工人时，他们想过要撤退。

sentences.en: But I had surmised, after all, this is a pretty large city.
sentences.zh: 但我推测，毕竟这是一个很大的城市。

sentences.en: There'd be more than one sign crew.
sentences.zh: 应该不止一个标志施工队。

sentences.en: My assumption was they'd think the other guy was doing it.
sentences.zh: 我的假设是他们会以为是对方在施工。

sentences.en: Richard parked his truck, and when everyone was in position with their cameras, he went to work.
sentences.zh: 理查德停好车，当所有人都带着摄像机就位后，他便开始工作了。

sentences.en: The hardest part really was getting over the razor wire with the ladder.
sentences.zh: 最难的部分其实是带着梯子翻过铁丝网。

sentences.en: Once he was up on the catwalk, nearly 30 feet above the highway, he started screwing in the new sign,
sentences.zh: 一旦他爬上猫道，距离高速公路近30英尺高的地方，他便开始拧上新标志，

sentences.en: careful not to drop any screws on the cars below.
sentences.zh: 小心翼翼地不让任何螺丝掉到下面的车上。

sentences.en: Halfway into it, we just felt like, okay, he's going to get away with it.
sentences.zh: 做到一半时，我们觉得，好吧，他能蒙混过关了。

sentences.en: Look at that.
sentences.zh: 看那个。

sentences.en: Is that amazing or what?
sentences.zh: 太神奇了，不是吗？

sentences.en: Oh, look, he's folding up his stuff.
sentences.zh: 哦，看，他在收东西了。

sentences.en: He's got it up.
sentences.zh: 他装好了。

sentences.en: The whole thing took less than 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 整个过程不到30分钟。

sentences.en: As soon as it was up, Richard packed up his ladder, rushed back to his truck, and blended back into the city.
sentences.zh: 标志一装好，理查德就收起梯子，冲回车里，融入了城市之中。

sentences.en: Awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I think we all went out to breakfast together afterwards, and we were super relieved and really happy.
sentences.zh: 我想我们之后一起去吃了早餐，我们感到超级如释重负，也非常开心。

sentences.en: Only a small group of people knew that the Interstate 5 shield, with the word North hanging above the 110 freeway, was a forgery.
sentences.zh: 只有一小群人知道那个悬挂在110号高速公路上方、带有“北”字的5号州际公路盾形标志是伪造的。

sentences.en: He didn't say to us, don't tell anyone, so our friends all knew about it, and we would drive by it, and we would just all feel really happy about it.
sentences.zh: 他没有对我们说“别告诉任何人”，所以我们的朋友都知道这件事，我们开车经过时，大家都会感到非常开心。

sentences.en: But it never sort of managed to leak out past that small group.
sentences.zh: 但它从未泄露给那个小圈子之外的人。

sentences.en: For a while.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间是这样。

sentences.en: For a while.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间。

sentences.en: For nine months, the secret stayed within a small community.
sentences.zh: 九个月来，这个秘密一直保存在一个小群体内。

sentences.en: And then Richard's friend Gary leaked the story.
sentences.zh: 然后理查德的朋友加里泄露了这个故事。

sentences.en: Oh, what the hell, Gary?
sentences.zh: 哦，搞什么鬼，加里？

sentences.en: Why can't you be cool?
sentences.zh: 你为什么就不能酷一点？

sentences.en: Just be cool, Gary.
sentences.zh: 酷一点吧，加里。

sentences.en: Richard's secret was out to Caltrans and to the press.
sentences.zh: 理查德的秘密被加州交通局和媒体知道了。

sentences.en: From the fake magnetic sign on his beat-up blue truck to a work order proclaiming Rush.
sentences.zh: 从他那辆破旧蓝色皮卡上的伪造磁性标志，到一份写着“加急”的工作单。

sentences.en: What he did is against the law, but Caltrans says it has no plans at all to foul charges against him.
sentences.zh: 他的行为触犯了法律，但加州交通局表示完全没有起诉他的计划。

sentences.en: After they found out what had happened, apparently they sent a crew out there to inspect it.
sentences.zh: 在他们发现发生了什么事后，显然他们派了一个施工队去现场检查。

sentences.en: Richard was hoping to get his sign back from Caltrans after they took it down.
sentences.zh: 理查德曾希望在加州交通局拆除标志后能拿回它。

sentences.en: He was thinking he would hang it in an art gallery.
sentences.zh: 他想把它挂在艺术画廊里。

sentences.en: But Caltrans didn't take the sign down.
sentences.zh: 但加州交通局并没有拆除那个标志。

sentences.en: It passed the Caltrans inspection, because that's really the final test of how good the artwork is.
sentences.zh: 它通过了加州交通局的检查，因为那才是衡量艺术品好坏的最终考验。

sentences.en: It stayed up for eight years, nine months, and 14 days, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我相信它在那里挂了八年、九个月零14天。

sentences.en: It's not exactly accurate, but it's pretty close to that.
sentences.zh: 不一定完全准确，但非常接近了。

sentences.en: In interviews about the incident with other news organizations,
sentences.zh: 在接受其他新闻机构关于此事的采访时，

sentences.en: Caltrans didn't exactly condone Richard's handiwork, but they were pretty kind about it.
sentences.zh: 加州交通局并没有完全纵容理查德的杰作，但他们的态度相当友善。

sentences.en: Here's the Caltrans spokesperson at the time.
sentences.zh: 这是当时加州交通局的发言人。

sentences.en: He did a good job, but we don't want him to do it again.
sentences.zh: 他做得很好，但我们不希望他再这么做了。

sentences.en: And in fact, he did such a good job that I'd like to offer him a job application.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他做得太好了，我甚至想给他一份工作申请表。

sentences.en: More than eight years after Richard's sign went up,
sentences.zh: 在理查德的标志安装八年多后，

sentences.en: he got a call from a friend who noticed some workers taking it down.
sentences.zh: 他接到一个朋友的电话，说看到有工人在拆除它。

sentences.en: Richard contacted Caltrans to ask if he could have his sign back.
sentences.zh: 理查德联系了加州交通局，询问是否能拿回他的标志。

sentences.en: By the time I tracked him down, it had already been crushed into a bale going for China.
sentences.zh: 等我找到它时，它已经被压成一捆，准备运往中国了。

sentences.en: And who knows what it turned into.
sentences.zh: 谁知道它变成了什么。

sentences.en: It could be a waffle iron by now.
sentences.zh: 现在它可能已经变成了一个华夫饼机。

sentences.en: After Caltrans took down Richard's sign, they replaced it with a brand new one.
sentences.zh: 加州交通局拆除理查德的标志后，换上了一个全新的。

sentences.en: But this time, they incorporated his ideas into the new design.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，他们将他的想法融入了新设计中。

sentences.en: They added the 5 North and the shield not only to that sign, but to two additional ones up the road.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅在那块标志上，还在路上的另外两块标志上增加了“5号北向”和盾形标志。

sentences.en: A little epilogue.
sentences.zh: 一个小尾声。

sentences.en: Richard's highway sign is a happily ever after story.
sentences.zh: 理查德的高速公路标志是一个“从此幸福快乐”的故事。

sentences.en: The sign worked.
sentences.zh: 标志起作用了。

sentences.en: People appreciated it.
sentences.zh: 人们很欣赏它。

sentences.en: No one got hurt, thankfully.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，没有人受伤。

sentences.en: Even Caltrans was really pretty nice about the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 甚至连加州交通局对整件事的态度都相当不错。

sentences.en: There's another gorilla sign story out of New York City.
sentences.zh: 纽约市又出现了一个“游击式”标识的故事。

sentences.en: A group that calls itself the Efficient Passenger Project has been hanging signs in New York subway stations
sentences.zh: 一个自称为“高效乘客项目”的团体一直在纽约地铁站张贴标识，

sentences.en: to tell people where they can board the train to make the most efficient transfers.
sentences.zh: 告诉人们在哪里上车可以实现最高效的换乘。

sentences.en: The project is not at all affiliated with the Metropolitan Transit Authority,
sentences.zh: 该项目与大都会运输署（MTA）毫无关联，

sentences.en: but the signs look just like MTA signs.
sentences.zh: 但这些标识看起来和MTA的标识一模一样。

sentences.en: Black with white Helvetica lettering.
sentences.zh: 黑底白字，使用Helvetica字体。

sentences.en: They say things like, board here for best transfer to the 4, 5, and 6 trains.
sentences.zh: 上面写着诸如“在此上车，可最方便地换乘4、5、6号线”之类的内容。

sentences.en: Or, board here for best transfer to F and M trains.
sentences.zh: 或者“在此上车，可最方便地换乘F线和M线”。

sentences.en: It's the kind of knowledge that you build up over time as a regular subway rider,
sentences.zh: 这是一种作为地铁常客随着时间推移而积累起来的知识，

sentences.en: and this gorilla sign maker is offering it to everyone.
sentences.zh: 而这位“游击式”标识制作者正将其提供给所有人。

sentences.en: And though some have applauded the signs, not all New Yorkers are pleased.
sentences.zh: 尽管有些人为这些标识喝彩，但并非所有纽约人都感到高兴。

sentences.en: These are secrets, some say.
sentences.zh: 有人说，这些是秘密。

sentences.en: That people should have to earn.
sentences.zh: 是人们应该通过自身经验去获取的。

sentences.en: They will unbalance the cars, they say.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这会造成车厢内乘客分布不均。

sentences.en: Leave signage to the experts.
sentences.zh: 标识的事还是留给专家去做吧。

sentences.en: The MTA, for their part, is taking down the signs as fast as they go up.
sentences.zh: MTA方面则是在这些标识刚贴出来时就迅速将其拆除。

sentences.en: MTA spokesman Kevin Ortiz told us in an email that, quote,
sentences.zh: MTA发言人凯文·奥尔蒂斯在邮件中告诉我们，引用如下：

sentences.en: posting of the signs is considered an act of vandalism.
sentences.zh: 张贴这些标识被视为一种破坏公物的行为。

sentences.en: Point being, if you decide to undertake an act of guerrilla public service,
sentences.zh: 重点是，如果你决定采取这种“游击式”的公共服务行为，

sentences.en: just know it may not be received as such.
sentences.zh: 要知道它可能并不会被视为一种服务。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by David Weinberg,
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》节目由大卫·温伯格制作，

sentences.en: with Katie Mingle, Sam Greenspan, Avery Truffleman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 参与制作的还有凯蒂·明格尔、萨姆·格林斯潘、艾弗里·特鲁夫曼，以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山KALW 91.7电台的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSyn,
sentences.zh: 在ArcSyn的办公室里制作，

sentences.en: an architecture and interiors firm.
sentences.zh: 那是一家建筑与室内设计公司。

sentences.en: Damn good one, if you ask me.
sentences.zh: 依我看，那是一家非常棒的公司。

sentences.en: If you ask anyone, really.
sentences.zh: 其实问谁都会这么说。

sentences.en: In beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 位于加利福尼亚州美丽的奥克兰市中心。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并点赞我们的节目。

sentences.en: We're all on Twitter and Instagram.
sentences.zh: 我们都在Twitter和Instagram上。

sentences.en: Avery runs the Tumblr.
sentences.zh: 艾弗里负责运营Tumblr。

sentences.en: I make the Spotify playlist of 99PI songs.
sentences.zh: 我制作了99PI歌曲的Spotify播放列表。

sentences.en: But I encourage you to explore the entire world of 99% Invisible
sentences.zh: 但我鼓励你去探索《99% Invisible》的整个世界，

sentences.en: at 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 网址是99PI.org。
